name: QSC_PROD_GRP_MAPS
description: This table is used to store a mapping from one product group hierarchy (which could be a graph) to another product group hierarchy (which could be a tree).

columns.name: PROD_GRP_MAP_ID
columns.description: Product Group Map Identifier. Primary Key.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ALGORITHM_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Algorithm Type Code.

columns.name: MAP_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Mapping Type Code.

columns.name: SRC_OBJ_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Source Object Type Code. Can be either Product Group or Product.

columns.name: SRC_OBJ_ID1
columns.description: Source Product Group Identifier or Source Product's inventory item identifier.

columns.name: SRC_OBJ_ID2
columns.description: Source product's inventory organization identifier. Used only if source object is a product.

columns.name: TRGT_OBJ_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Mapped object code identifier. Can be either product group or product.

columns.name: TRGT_ROOT_ID
columns.description: Root product group identifier in target hierarchy.

columns.name: TRGT_PATH_ID
columns.description: Persistent identifier of the path from root to the object in target hierarchy.

columns.name: TRGT_PAR_OBJ_ID
columns.description: Immediate parent of the target product group object.

columns.name: TRGT_OBJ_ID1
columns.description: Mapped product's inventory item identifier or Product Group Identifier

columns.name: TRGT_OBJ_ID2
columns.description: Target product's inventory organization identifier. Used only if target object is a product.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Date from which the mapping is active.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Date after which the mapping is no longer active.

columns.name: TRGT_DEPTH_NUM
columns.description: Depth of the target path.

columns.name: RECORD_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Used to store the type of search results.

columns.name: RECORD_TYPE_NUM
columns.description: Internal column to determine the type of record.

columns.name: ADMIN_STATUS_NUM
columns.description: Internal column used to store admin status.

columns.name: RUNTIME_STATUS_NUM
columns.description: Internal column used to store runtime status.

columns.name: BATCH_KEY
columns.description: Holds transient information about the batch process that is updating the map.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).
